slots.name: trips
slots.about: trips in any order: id (1 up), name, dates (the range as words), start and end (dates, end on or after start)

slots.name: hero_line
slots.about: the countdown on the big card; may read hero_now (a trip is under way), hero_until (days to its start), hero_day and hero_len (day N of M while under way)

slots.name: later_title
slots.about: the heading over the other coming trips

slots.name: later_line
slots.about: a coming row's second line; may read it.dates and it.until (days to its start, 0 or less once under way)

slots.name: past_title
slots.about: the fold row over past trips; may read past_count

slots.name: past_line
slots.about: a past row's second line; may read it.dates and it.ago (days since it ended)

slots.name: empty_line
slots.about: in place of the big card when nothing is coming or under way

slots.name: open
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: opens a trip from a row (value: it.id); the big card sends hero_id itself; the last opened row is tinted when you come back

slots.name: toggle_past
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: folds or unfolds the past trips (folded at the start)

empty.shows: the empty line in place of the big card; past trips stay below

attention.shows: the trip under way is the big card and its line counts the day of the trip

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, swap, smooth and shrink
accessibility.not_colour_alone: the countdown and each row's line say when in words; past rows are dimmed and also say how long ago
